content.title: Paul Thomas Anderson, Maya Rudolph Share Rare Kiss After His Golden Globes 2026 Win
content.text: Golden Globe Awards 2026 Must-See Moments: 'Heated Rivalry' Stars, Teyana Taylor's Emotional Win0 seconds of 2 minutes, 38 secondsVolume 0%Golden Globe Awards 2026 Must-See Moments: 'Heated Rivalry' Stars, Teyana Taylor's Emotional WinPaul Thomas Anderson and Maya Rudolph are having one adorable moment after another. The longtime couple surprised fans as they shared a sweet kiss when Paul picked up the award for Best Screenplay, Motion Picture for One Battle After Another at the 2026 Golden Globes at the Beverly Hilton on Jan. 11 and again when he won the award for Best Director. When the director’s name was first called for Best Screenplay by Macaulay Culkin, the 55-year-old turned to his partner of over 25 years and the two shared a rare kiss. Maya, 53, later stood up to plant another kiss on Paul when Judd Apatow announced him as the evening’s Best Director. (Click here for all the winners.) While Paul didn’t give Maya a shoutout during his acceptance speeches, he did make sure to thank his cast, including Leonardo DiCaprio, Teyana Taylor, Benicio Del Toro, Sean Penn, Chase Infiniti and Regina Hall. “The moment when it gets out of your room and off a page and actors start saying it,” he told the crowd, “that’s when it gets great.”And equally great has been his long relationship with Maya, as well as their four children Pearl, 20, Lucille, 16, Jack, 14, and Minnie, 12. "It’s pretty Von Trapp," he joked with the LA Times in 2018. "I don’t know that movie that well. But there’s a scene in You Can’t Take It with You where a woman enters and there’s 50 different family members all banging away on different things in different parts of the house. It’s a little like that. This one’s banging on the piano. This one’s banging on the drum. This one’s singing. It’s very chaotic."CBSBut among the chaos, the Inherent Vice director knew almost immediately that Maya would be someone special in his life, with the Saturday Night Live alum recounting how they met. "He said he saw me in a sketch and said, ‘That’s the girl I’m going to marry,’” Maya told Town & Country in 2024. “But I don’t know. I wasn’t there. Maybe he just told me that to be sweet.” And as Paul explained, he knew he had to meet her after seeing her name on a piece of paper. Monica Schipper/Getty Images"I don't know if you've had any feeling like this,” he said on SmartLess in 2022, “but you see something for the first time and you realize that my life has just changed. I don't know how, I don't know why." "Looking back, obviously that kind of impulse, that shining kind of feeling that can happen to any of us if we're open to it, happened,” he continued. “So, I roamed around and then I saw her on television and I saw what she was doing. And I stayed in touch with a few people from the show and I was like, 'My God, this woman's amazing.'"
